name: Filter by Status Code
original: status>=400
query: http_response.code>=400

name: Combine Filters
original: source_type=apache status>=400 method="POST"
query: source_type=apache http_response.code>=400 method="POST"

name: Not Equal Filter
original: status!=200
query: http_response.code!=200

name: Numeric Range
query: traffic.bytes_out>1000000

name: IN Operator
query: http_response.code IN (401, 403, 404)

name: CIDR Network Filter
original: src_ip IN CIDR "10.0.0.0/8"
query: * | where cidr_match(src_ip, "10.0.0.0/8")

name: Count by Status
original: source_type=apache | stats count() by status
query: source_type=apache | stats count() by http_response.code

name: Average Response Size
original: source_type=apache | stats avg(bytes) as avg_bytes
query: source_type=apache | stats avg(traffic.bytes_out) as avg_bytes

name: Sum of Bytes Transferred
original: source_type=apache | stats sum(bytes) as total_bytes
query: source_type=apache | stats sum(traffic.bytes_out) as total_bytes

name: Min/Max Values
original: * | stats min(bytes) as min_bytes, max(bytes) as max_bytes
query: * | stats min(traffic.bytes_out) as min_bytes, max(traffic.bytes_out) as max_bytes

name: Multiple Aggregations
original: * | stats count() as events, dc(src_ip) as unique_ips, sum(bytes) as total_bytes by source_type
query: * | stats count() as events, dc(src_ip) as unique_ips, sum(traffic.bytes_out) as total_bytes by source_type

name: Percentiles
original: source_type=apache | stats p50(response_time) as median, p95(response_time) as p95, p99(response_time) as p99
query: source_type=apache | stats percentile(duration, 50) as median, percentile(duration, 95) as p95, percentile(duration, 99) as p99

name: Errors Over Time
original: status>=400 | bin span=1h | stats count() by _time
query: http_response.code>=400 | bin span=1h | stats count() by _time

name: High Risk Entities (24h)
original: source_type=signals | bin span=24h | stats sum(risk_score) as total_risk by risk_entity | where total_risk > 80
query: source_type=risk | mvexpand resources.name | rename resources.name as risk_entity | bin span=24h | stats sum(risk_score) as total_risk by risk_entity | where total_risk > 80

name: High Risk Entities (7d)
original: source_type=signals | bin span=7d | stats sum(risk_score) as total_risk by risk_entity | where total_risk > 90
query: source_type=risk | mvexpand resources.name | rename resources.name as risk_entity | bin span=7d | stats sum(risk_score) as total_risk by risk_entity | where total_risk > 90

name: Top Risky IPs
original: source_type=signals | stats sum(risk_score) as total_risk, count() as signal_count by risk_entity | sort -total_risk | head 20
query: source_type=risk | mvexpand resources.name | rename resources.name as risk_entity | stats sum(risk_score) as total_risk, count() as signal_count by risk_entity | sort -total_risk | head 20

name: Signals by Rule
original: source_type=signals | stats count() by rule_name | sort -count
query: source_type=findings | stats count() by finding_info.analytic.name | sort -count

name: Alert Timeline
original: source_type=signals signal_type=alert | bin span=1h | stats count() by _time
query: source_type=findings finding_info.types=alert | bin span=1h | stats count() by _time

name: Risk Accumulation Rate
original: source_type=signals | bin span=1h | stats sum(risk_score) as hourly_risk by risk_entity, _time | sort risk_entity, _time
query: source_type=risk | mvexpand resources.name | rename resources.name as risk_entity | bin span=1h | stats sum(risk_score) as hourly_risk by risk_entity, _time | sort risk_entity, _time

name: Top Destinations
original: * | stats count() as connections by dst_ip | sort -connections | head 20
query: * | stats count() as connections by dst_endpoint.ip | sort -connections | head 20

name: Data Transfer by IP
original: * | stats sum(bytes) as total_bytes by src_ip | sort -total_bytes | head 20
query: * | stats sum(traffic.bytes_out) as total_bytes by src_ip | sort -total_bytes | head 20

name: Internal vs External Traffic
original: src_ip IN CIDR "10.0.0.0/8" OR src_ip IN CIDR "192.168.0.0/16" OR src_ip IN CIDR "172.16.0.0/12" | stats count() as internal_traffic
query: * | where cidr_match(src_ip, "10.0.0.0/8") OR cidr_match(src_ip, "192.168.0.0/16") OR cidr_match(src_ip, "172.16.0.0/12") | stats count() as internal_traffic

name: Port Scan Detection
original: * | stats dc(dst_port) as unique_ports by src_ip | where unique_ports > 100 | sort -unique_ports
query: * | stats dc(dst_endpoint.port) as unique_ports by src_ip | where unique_ports > 100 | sort -unique_ports

name: Unusual Ports
original: dst_port NOT IN (80, 443, 22, 21, 25, 53) | stats count() by dst_port | sort -count | head 20
query: dst_endpoint.port NOT IN (80, 443, 22, 21, 25, 53) | stats count() by dst_endpoint.port | sort -count | head 20

name: Failed Logins
original: action=login status=failure
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 status_id=2

name: Failed Logins by User
original: action=login status=failure | stats count() as failures by user | sort -failures | head 20
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 status_id=2 | stats count() as failures by user | sort -failures | head 20

name: Failed Logins by IP
original: action=login status=failure | stats count() as failures by src_ip | sort -failures | head 20
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 status_id=2 | stats count() as failures by src_ip | sort -failures | head 20

name: Brute Force Detection
original: action=login status=failure | bin span=5m | stats count() as attempts by src_ip, _time | where attempts > 10
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 status_id=2 | bin span=5m | stats count() as attempts by src_ip, _time | where attempts > 10

name: Successful Logins After Failures
original: action=login | stats count(eval(status="failure")) as failures, count(eval(status="success")) as successes by user | where failures > 5 AND successes > 0
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 | stats count(eval(status_id=2)) as failures, count(eval(status_id=1)) as successes by user | where failures > 5 AND successes > 0

name: Login Times
original: action=login status=success | eval hour=strftime("%H", timestamp) | stats count() by hour | sort hour
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 status_id=1 | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(timestamp, "%H")) | stats count() by hour | sort hour

name: Off-Hours Logins
original: action=login status=success | eval hour=strftime("%H", timestamp) | where hour < 8 OR hour > 18
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1 status_id=1 | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(timestamp, "%H")) | where hour < 8 OR hour > 18

name: HTTP Error Rate
original: source_type=apache | stats count() as total, count(eval(status>=400)) as errors | eval error_rate=round(errors/total*100, 2)
query: source_type=apache | stats count() as total, count(eval(http_response.code>=400)) as errors | eval error_rate=round(errors/total*100, 2)

name: 404 Not Found
original: source_type=apache status=404 | stats count() by uri | sort -count | head 20
query: source_type=apache http_response.code=404 | stats count() by uri | sort -count | head 20

name: 500 Server Errors
original: source_type=apache status>=500 | stats count() by uri, status | sort -count
query: source_type=apache http_response.code>=500 | stats count() by uri, http_response.code | sort -count

name: Slow Requests
original: source_type=apache response_time>5000 | stats count() by uri | sort -count | head 20
query: source_type=apache duration>5000 | stats count() by uri | sort -count | head 20

name: Large Responses
original: source_type=apache bytes>10000000 | stats count() by uri | sort -count
query: source_type=apache traffic.bytes_out>10000000 | stats count() by uri | sort -count

name: User Agents
original: source_type=apache | stats count() by user_agent | sort -count | head 20
query: source_type=apache | stats count() by http_request.user_agent | sort -count | head 20

name: Bot Detection
original: source_type=apache user_agent="*bot*" OR user_agent="*crawler*" OR user_agent="*spider*" | stats count() by user_agent, src_ip
query: source_type=apache http_request.user_agent="*bot*" OR http_request.user_agent="*crawler*" OR http_request.user_agent="*spider*" | stats count() by http_request.user_agent, src_ip

name: Suspicious User Agents
original: user_agent="*sqlmap*" OR user_agent="*nikto*" OR user_agent="*nmap*" OR user_agent="*masscan*"
query: http_request.user_agent="*sqlmap*" OR http_request.user_agent="*nikto*" OR http_request.user_agent="*nmap*" OR http_request.user_agent="*masscan*"

name: Rare User Agents
original: source_type=apache | stats count() as requests by user_agent | where requests < 10 | sort requests
query: source_type=apache | stats count() as requests by http_request.user_agent | where requests < 10 | sort requests

name: Geographic Anomaly
original: * | stats dc(src_ip) as unique_ips, count() as requests by country | sort -requests
query: * | stats dc(src_ip) as unique_ips, count() as requests by src_endpoint.location.country | sort -requests

name: Data Exfiltration
original: bytes>50000000 | stats sum(bytes) as total_bytes by src_ip, dst_ip | sort -total_bytes | head 20
query: traffic.bytes_out>50000000 | stats sum(traffic.bytes_out) as total_bytes by src_ip, dst_endpoint.ip | sort -total_bytes | head 20

name: Beaconing Detection
original: * | bin span=1m | stats count() as connections by src_ip, dst_ip, _time | stats stdev(connections) as stdev, avg(connections) as avg by src_ip, dst_ip | where stdev < 1 AND avg > 0
query: * | bin span=1m | stats count() as connections by src_ip, dst_endpoint.ip, _time | stats stdev(connections) as stdev, avg(connections) as avg by src_ip, dst_endpoint.ip | where stdev < 1 AND avg > 0

name: Error Summary
original: status>=400 | stats count() by source_type, status | sort source_type, status
query: http_response.code>=400 | stats count() by source_type, http_response.code | sort source_type, http_response.code

name: Security Posture
original: * | stats count() as total_events, count(eval(status>=400)) as errors, dc(src_ip) as unique_sources
query: * | stats count() as total_events, count(eval(http_response.code>=400)) as errors, dc(src_ip) as unique_sources

name: Traffic by Hour of Day
original: * | eval hour=strftime("%H", timestamp) | stats count() by hour | sort hour
query: * | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(timestamp, "%H")) | stats count() by hour | sort hour

name: After Hours Activity
original: * | eval hour=strftime("%H", timestamp) | where hour < 6 OR hour > 22 | stats count() by src_ip, hour
query: * | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(timestamp, "%H")) | where hour < 6 OR hour > 22 | stats count() by src_ip, hour

name: Hourly Heatmap Data
original: * | eval hour=strftime("%H", timestamp), day=strftime("%A", timestamp) | stats count() by day, hour
query: * | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(timestamp, "%H")), day=strftime(timestamp, "%A") | stats count() by day, hour

name: Filter by Action
original: action="login"
query: class_uid=3002 activity_id=1
